psql is the PostgreSQL interactive terminal.

Usage:
  psql [OPTION]... [DBNAME [USERNAME]]

General options:
  -c, --command=COMMAND    run a single command and exit
  -d, --dbname=DBNAME      database name to connect to
  -f, --file=FILENAME      execute commands from a file and exit
  -l, --list               list available databases and exit
  -v, --set=NAME=VALUE     set psql variable NAME to VALUE
  -x, --expanded           turn on expanded table output
  -q, --quiet              run quietly (no welcome message or prompts)
  -h, --host=HOSTNAME      database server host or socket directory

Input and output options:
  -a, --echo-all           echo all input from script
  -e, --echo-echo          echo commands sent to server
  -n, --no-readline        disable readline history and command editing
